title: ewa-empire-underground
label: El Pablo

won.source: The fed's own news entry 6 (20 May 2011) congratulates El Pablo on winning the Underground title “on Shatter Point”; entry 3 (19 May 2011) posts the results of Shatter Point 5/17/11, the only show the fed staged between its own site opening and that congratulation.

how: Won on Shatter Point; the fed's own news announced it and reminded the roster that 24/7 rules meant it could go at any time.
note: Lost the title to Chris Johnson at Retaliation; Chris Johnson's own Casting Couch segment on Shatter Point 7/5/11 calls his Retaliation win his own, and the belt is his going into that show.

title: ewa-empire-world-heavyweight
label: Justin Marsham

won.source: Justin Marsham's own Shatter Point 7/5/11 promo, recounting a Stairway to Death match win over Buzzsaw at Retaliation; the fed's own news of 25 June 2011 reports gold changing hands at Retaliation without naming the belt.

how: Won the title from Buzzsaw in a Stairway to Death match at Retaliation, by his own account on Shatter Point 7/5/11.

title: ewa-empire-world-heavyweight
label: Buzzsaw

won.source: No won date survives; the fed's own news of 24 May 2011 bills him as the reigning EWA World Champion.

how: Billed as the reigning World Champion in the fed's own news of 24 May 2011, with a major announcement booked for the 6 June show; lost the title to Justin Marsham at Retaliation in a Stairway to Death match, by Marsham's own account on Shatter Point 7/5/11. The fed's own text also credits one successful defense against Tim Timmons somewhere in the reign, with no date or card recovered for it.
note: Neither the start nor the end of this reign is in the surviving record; the fed's own news of 25 June 2011 reports that gold changed hands at Retaliation without saying which belts.

title: ewa-empire-underground
label: Chris Johnson

won.source: Chris Johnson billed as reigning Underground Champion on Shatter Point 7/5/11, celebrating a Retaliation win on his own Casting Couch segment; the fed's own news of 25 June 2011 reports gold changing hands at Retaliation without naming the belt.

how: Won the title at Retaliation. Lost it on Shatter Point 7/5/11 under the belt's own 24/7 rules — pinned by a surprise-entrant Waylon Krews (the Krewsplitter, onto a steel chair) mid-way through an unrelated tag match, while defending champion Chris Johnson was the legal man against El Fuego.

title: ewa-empire-underground
label: Waylon Krews

won.source: Shatter Point 7/5/11: Waylon Krews runs in on the Payne/Johnson vs. El Fuego tag match, hits the Krewsplitter on legal man Chris Johnson onto a steel chair, and the referee counts the pin under the Underground Championship's own 24/7 rules.

how: Won the title mid-match on Shatter Point 7/5/11 under the belt's own 24/7 rules, then fled through the crowd with it, Jackson Cage in pursuit.

title: ewa-empire-tag-team
label: Home Town Heroes

won.source: Home Town Heroes billed and celebrated as EWA's first Tag Team Champions on Shatter Point 7/5/11, crowned in a triple threat at Retaliation over Total Mayhem and the Sons of Ohio/Wreckers pairing.

how: Won a triple threat at Retaliation over Total Mayhem and a Sons of Ohio/Wreckers pairing to become the promotion's first Tag Team Champions.

title: ewa-empire-international
label: Buck Evans

won.source: Billed as the reigning International Champion on Shatter Point 7/5/11, retaining against Alexander Slate after Big Nasty's attack left Slate unable to compete; no won date survives.

how: Champion by the time of Shatter Point 7/5/11's own broadcast; the belt's own history page was never captured.
